acceptance_criteria.hook: Promessa identificavel nos primeiros 3 segundos, sem introducao de canal
acceptance_criteria.reward: O roteiro precisa responder a pergunta ou revelar a ideia antes de terminar
acceptance_criteria.retention_measure: Comparar primeira janela de 48 horas de cada Short; nao comparar uploads com diferentes idades
acceptance_criteria.animation: Aprovar movimento real de personagem/objetos quando possivel; nao declarar zoom como animacao articulada
acceptance_criteria.metadata: Relevancia por video; remover termos desconexos; priorizar titulo e descricao
acceptance_criteria.production: Manter pausa e sem upload ate aprovacao do criador

notes: Two of the five leaders are Death Note, not three.
Reported 130 Shorts views average is not equal to overall 7753/69 = 112.36, possibly due to different filters/windows.
The five Shorts posted today with zero views have not yet matured; 48h comparisons needed.
High publishing volume potentially affects measurement and audience overlap; it is not proof the recommendation algorithm penalized uploads.
Do not treat 55.09% average retention as proof every Short is high quality.

prioritize: character-specific curiosity with a truthful answer
consistent original visuals rather than zoom-only
editorial_strategy_v3.title_policy: Character + specific verifiable fact or surprising question, optional restrained uppercase/emojis; no formula lock-in, no misleading promises

longform_hypothesis.frequency: one pilot only after short-form tests and creator approval
longform_hypothesis.source_policy: fresh original factual screenplay and transformed visuals, not Shorts concatenated verbatim

editorial_strategy_v3.causality_warning: Organic distribution fluctuations and time-of-day effects require matched comparison; do not attribute them solely to posting volume
